arStrings.szText: Purchased from the Altar of the Psyche at the Tree of Whispers.

Damage done by your {c_important}Witchcraft{/c} Effects afflicts enemies with {c_important}Hex of Shattering{/c} causing them to deal {c_random}[SF_0*100|1x%|]{/c} reduced damage for {c_number}[SF_1]{/c} seconds.{if:SF_8} In addition, when any {c_important}Hex{/c} Effect is applied to Headrotten, all damage will be guaranteed Critical Strikes for {c_number}{SF_11}{/c} seconds.{/if}
